issues.description: The PersonResource constructor has a different parameter type in the solution than in the template. The template declares a constructor taking a PersonService and assigns it to the personService field, while the solution's constructor takes a String (but still assigns to the PersonService-typed field). This mismatch will cause a compilation error and prevents Spring from correctly wiring the controller.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the constructor in src/main/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/rest/PersonResource.java (solution) to accept a PersonService parameter (public PersonResource(PersonService personService)) and assign it to the personService field. This makes the constructor consistent with the template and allows Spring to inject the service.
